WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT * FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT * FROM "sportathon_endline"
)
SELECT 
  "Location",
  NULLIF(SUM(endline."Shuttle Run sec") - SUM(baseline."Shuttle Run sec"), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(endline."Shuttle Run sec") + SUM(baseline."Shuttle Run sec"), 0) * 100 AS "average shuttle run improvement or decline"
FROM baseline
JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID"
GROUP BY "Location"
